caption: The drawing features a botanical motif and an outline of a vessel. The central area of the image is occupied by a plant with broad, curved leaves and flower-like shapes, all rendered in shades of very dark blue to black watercolor or ink, with some white highlights and dotted patterns for texture and detail. The plant has multiple branches, and the leaves and buds are stylized with a slightly abstract form. On the lower right side of the image, there is a lightly sketched outline of a jug or ceramic vessel in pencil or a similar light medium, with a handle and a short neck. On the surface of the jug, there is a replication of the plant motif, also sketched lightly. The background of the artwork is a uniform tan or beige color, possibly the natural color of the paper on which the objects are drawn. The artist's name, “Yolande DeLasser,” is written in small letters in pencil in the lower left corner.
title: Jug
